svg.text: Prototype screen map — the six screens the Part 2 design must show
Drawn at wireframe fidelity; colour appears only where the real screen carries data (charts, totals, states)
MoMo / VNPay / COD / Apple Pay / PayPal
Chart.js bar chart + table, one card per group
A hub at 90% or more rejects new orders (BR8)
One card per hub, sortable, exportable to CSV
Date range is shared by both reports
Menu and brands for a hub
Only items of brands this hub operates appear (FR-A6)
Unavailable items are shown dashed, not orderable (FR-A5)
The worked example of SC-001, reproduced line by line
One rounding, at the end — no intermediate rounding (BR10)
Every step number 1–9 of BR10 is visible to the customer
MoMo and VNPay never render for a Tourist, and the
server refuses them even if the request is forged (FR-S2).
COD is hidden when the rounded total is over 1,000,000
(FR-P2, BR14); the strategy re-checks it anyway.
Three buttons or two — the list comes from AvailableFor()
Cancelled and Failed appear here too,
as terminal steps with their reason (A2).
A COD order keeps "Delivered" disabled until the shipper
